page_title: GithubStarsManager — AI-Powered GitHub Stars, Forks & Gists Manager

summary.name: GithubStarsManager
summary.one_liner: A local-first desktop and web app that uses AI to categorize, search, and track your GitHub stars, forks, and Gists.
use_cases: organize a large list of starred GitHub repos into categories
find a repo you starred earlier using natural language
track new releases of favorite tools and grab the right installer
keep forks in sync with upstream repositories
ask questions about a repository's code and docs
manage and search code snippets stored as GitHub Gists
summary.what_it_does: Syncs your GitHub stars, forks, and Gists into a local library, then uses AI (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or local Ollama) to summarize repos, extract tags, and assign them to categories. Offers keyword, natural-language, and vector semantic search, plus a Repository Q&A assistant that answers questions with file:line citations. Includes release tracking with a timeline and platform-specific installer selection, fork sync with upstream detection and GitHub Actions triggers, and a Gist browser with AI summaries. A built-in local MCP server lets Claude Desktop, Cursor, or other MCP clients query the library.
notable: Built-in MCP server on a loopback, token-protected endpoint for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and other MCP clients
Repository Q&A with citations down to file:line
Discovery hub combining GitHub trending, X and Telegram channels, Ruan Yifeng Weekly picks, and grep.app code search
Sandboxed plugin platform with a community registry and SHA-256 integrity checks
caveats: AI features require your own OpenAI, Anthropic, or Ollama API key or a local Ollama setup
GitHub Lists sync is marked experimental
Optional WebDAV sync and self-hosted backend are not required for basic use
